capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Declare `"sources": [{ "type": "clock", "intervalMs": 1000 }]` when displaying live clocks or multi-timezone panels.
- Built-in expression function `tz('<zoneId>', '<format>')` and `tz('<zoneId>', '<format>', <offsetHours>)`:
  - Supported `<zoneId>`: IANA IDs (`"Asia/Shanghai"`, `"Asia/Tokyo"`, `"Europe/London"`, `"Europe/Berlin"`, `"America/New_York"`, `"America/Los_Angeles"`, `"Australia/Sydney"`, `"Asia/Singapore"`), `"UTC"`, `"local"`, or fixed offsets (`"UTC+8"`, `"UTC-5"`).
  - Supported `<format>`: standard .NET time patterns (`"HH:mm"`, `"HH:mm:ss"`, `"MM-dd HH:mm"`, `"ddd HH:mm"`, `"zzz"` for UTC offsets).
  - Optional `<offsetHours>` (default 0, supports halves like 2.5) shifts the reference instant forward — pair with a scrubber Slider bound to `state.scrubHours`.
- Semantic helpers (all DST-correct via `TimeZoneInfo`, zero reflection):
  - `tzDiffLabel('<zoneId>', <offsetHours>?)` → localized relative-diff + cross-day label (`"慢 7h · 同日"` / `"behind 7h · yesterday"`).
  - `tzWorkState('<zoneId>', '<workWindow>', <offsetHours>?)` → `"work"` / `"edge"` (07:00–start, end–22:00) / `"sleep"` (22:00–07:00).
  - `tzCity('<zoneId>')` → localized display name of 24 built-in business cities (13 locales).
- Exact `$clock.*` tokens: `${$clock.fullTime}`, `${$clock.seconds}`, `${$clock.utcTime}`, `${$clock.utcFullTime}`, `${$clock.utcDate}`, `${$clock.localOffset}`, `${$clock.unixSeconds}`, `${$clock.iso}`.

members.descriptionEn: Offline JWT decode with exp/nbf diagnostics (`${$transform.jwtState}`), CJK Unicode escape round-trips, JSON string escapes, and no-dash UUIDs

members.descriptionEn: The same operators are callable inline inside string interpolation expressions (offline, zero-reflection); failures return an empty string

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Optional `"sources": [{ "type": "clipboard", "intervalMs": 2000 }]` exposes `${$clipboard.text}`, `${$clipboard.preview}`, `${$clipboard.length}`, `${$clipboard.lines}`, `${$clipboard.kind}` (`"json"`|`"jwt"`|`"unicodeEscape"`|`"url"`|`"urlEncoded"`|`"base64"`|`"timestamp"`|`"hexColor"`|`"number"`|`"text"`|`"empty"`), `${$clipboard.kindLabel}`, `${$clipboard.hasText}`.
- Action `text.transform`:
  `{ "type": "text.transform", "format": "jsonPretty", "text": "${state.rawText}", "key": "resultText", "mode": "copy" }`
  - If `"text"` is omitted and `clipboard` source is active, transforms current clipboard text directly.
  - Writes output to `state.<key>` (plus `state.transformOutput` and `${$transform.resultText}`); `"mode": "copy"` also copies the result to the system clipboard.
  - Supported `format` operations: `"jsonPretty"`, `"jsonPretty4"`, `"jsonMinify"`, `"jsonEscape"`, `"jsonUnescape"`, `"urlEncode"`, `"urlDecode"`, `"base64Encode"`, `"base64Decode"`, `"jwtDecode"`, `"unicodeEscape"`, `"unicodeUnescape"`, `"timestampToDate"`, `"dateToTimestamp"`, `"dateToTimestampMs"`, `"uuid"`, `"uuidNoDash"` (plus case variants `"uuidUpper"` / `"uuidNoDashUpper"`), `"upper"`, `"lower"`, `"trim"`, `"wordCount"`, `"sha256"`, `"md5"`.
  - `jwtDecode` is offline Base64Url decode only (signature is NOT verified); it prepends an exp/nbf status line and sets `${$transform.jwtState}` to `"valid"`, `"expired"`, `"noexp"`, or `"invalid"` after the action.
  - Every operator above is also callable directly inside expressions: `${jwtdecode($clipboard.text)}`, `${unicodeunescape('\u4e2d\u6587')}`, `${uuid()}`, `${timestamptodate(1700000000)}`.

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Optional sidecar `logic.js` runs inside an offline QuickJS ES2023 sandbox (no network/DOM/filesystem, <= 50 ms CPU, <= 4 MB RAM, zero idle memory).
- Declare `"script": { "entry": "logic.js", "tickIntervalMs": 0 }` in `manifest.json` (`tickIntervalMs` is `0` or `1000..3600000`, auto-paused when widget is hidden).
- `ctx` provides `ctx.state` (persisted string map), `ctx.collections` (persisted record arrays), `ctx.settings` (read-only), `ctx.computed` (ephemeral scalar/array map read via `${$computed.<key>}` or `"items": "$computed.<listKey>"`), `ctx.locale`, `ctx.nowIso`, and `ctx.t(key, ...args)`.
- Always export `onInit(ctx)` to populate initial `ctx.computed.*` values so cold start never shows blank placeholders; optionally export `onSourceData(ctx, sourceId, rawText)`, `onTick(ctx, nowUnixMs)`, and custom handlers invoked by `{ "type": "script.run", "fn": "<name>", "arg": "<expr>" }`.
- Structured `args`, UI `ctx.event`, & Host Action Dispatch: pass `"args": { "row": 1, "col": 2 }` on `script.run` and read `ctx.args` inside `logic.js`; interactive controls (`Canvas.onItemClick`, `List.onReorder`, `List.onInlineCommit`, `Slider.onChange`) populate `ctx.event` (`{ id, x, y, value, fromIndex, toIndex }`); call `ctx.dispatch({ type: 'toast.show', title: 'Done', message: '...' })` (up to 8 actions) to trigger host actions from script; export `onHttpResponse(ctx, res)` or `onCommandResult(ctx, res)` to process async results.

- Polling floor for `httpJson` / `rss` is `15000` ms (`15s`). `https://` requires `PublicNetwork` permission; `http://` / `localhost` / LAN IPs require `LocalNetwork` permission (locally created widgets enable permissions automatically; users can toggle permissions anytime in Widget Settings).
- If `logic.js` exports `export function onHttpResponse(ctx, res)`, it receives `{ actionId, url, status, ok, bodyText, json }` and can update `ctx.state`, `ctx.computed`, or `ctx.dispatch(...)`.
